text_block_list.text:
When I came to the training course this 
evening――

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Hey there! Nice running, Spee!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: Spee-senpai? Spee-senpai?

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Whoa! S-Sorry! The potatoes in Hokkaido 
are sweet and delicious!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…That's not what we're talking about. 
*sigh* Come here, Senpai.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What's wrong? You look like you're out of 
space.

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
A-Ahaha. Did they find out? Well, 
actually…

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
There's something I want to try. But I 
can't do it alone…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text: …So you're worried about it? Hmm…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Heheh, I've decided! I'll leave the rest 
of my time to you!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
I don't know what you're trying to do, but 
I'm coming with you!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Huh? That's bad! I thought Vodka had 
plans…

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
It's okay! My dad used to tell me to 
listen to my own voice when making 
decisions.

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
No matter what other people say, I have to 
be cool and choose something exciting!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
Anyway, I wanna see you try it! That's way 
more exciting!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
…! Th-Thank you so much! I didn't think 
you'd say that!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text: Okay… I'll do it. Vodka, come with me!

text_block_list.name: Special Week
text_block_list.text:
Come on, let's try out the 'Carrot Ramen 
Super Explosion Abra Massive Pair Set'!!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
What?! You're talking about food?! Isn't 
that a bit much?!

text_block_list.name: Vodka
text_block_list.text:
…But now that I've said we'll do it 
together, there's nothing to worry about. 
Let's give it a try!

Vodka ran off to the Chinese restaurant 
for her special week and excitement.
